verdict.rationale: Greptile's own security page reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data and use it to train AI models, with no documented opt-out for the hosted service. The only route to keeping data out of training is to self-host in your own VPC or air-gapped environment, which can also use your own LLMs, along with the option to turn off logging. That is an infrastructure workaround, not a training opt-out. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out from AI training on the hosted service, a contractual no-training commitment covering de-identified data, and independent corroboration.
